verdict.rationale: Canny is a SaaS feedback platform that stores customer and user data, so data retention and deletion controls are a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack has no documented retention settings, deletion workflows, data-purge APIs, or retention policies. The MCP, integration, SSO and widget items do not address the story, and the API reference appears only as a title with no deletion endpoints shown.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
